name: Tend - Family Care Circle
shortDescription: Voice-first family care circle for Alexa+, coordinating medication logging, check-ins, tasks, and daily spoken briefings.
fullDescription:
Tend is an ambient, voice-first family care circle living inside Alexa+, engineered specifically for families supporting an aging parent. Without requiring parents to adopt complex smartphone apps, Tend empowers elders to log routines hands-free and allows adult children to stay informed through actionable spoken briefings.

Key Capabilities:
1. Elder Voice Logging: Elders can speak naturally to their Echo devices in the kitchen or bedroom to log scheduled medication doses or confirm daily check-ins.
2. Spoken Daily Briefings: Family caregivers can ask Alexa how Mom is doing at any time to hear an empathetic, deterministic summary of medications, well-being, open tasks, and appointments.
3. Shared Sibling Coordination: Keep siblings and family members aligned with a synchronized care task board that prevents duplicate calls and forgotten pharmacy refills.
4. Screen-Enabled Care Board: On Echo Show and Alexa+ screen devices, Tend renders an interactive, glanceable Care Board via the official MCP App standard.
5. Privacy & Safety First: Tend coordinates family care and does not provide clinical diagnoses, dosing adjustments, or emergency medical dispatch.
examplePhrases: Alexa, tell Tend I took my morning pills.
Alexa, ask Tend how Mom is doing today.
Alexa, ask Tend what care tasks are open.
Alexa, tell Tend to add a note: Mom's knee is feeling better.
